src: Adds a structured campaign on top of Science Mode with an in-game mission menu, campaign atlas, stations, bases, supply routes and deep-space exploration. CKAN installs the plugin separately from its campaign profile and asks whether to use the recommended Stock Kerbol campaign or the optional SOL real-solar-system campaign.
zh: 在科学模式之上添加结构化战役，包含游戏内任务菜单、战役星图、空间站、基地、补给路线和深空探索。CKAN 会将插件与其战役配置分开安装，并询问使用推荐的 Stock Kerbol 战役还是可选的 SOL 真实太阳系战役。

src: Universal Aeronautics and Space Systems in collaboration with Kerbal-Tech(K-Tech) presents the T.R.A.P(Tetrahedral Re-expansion Air Propulsor) Engine, the first in a line of new parts. This engine offers good performance at low altitudes, however, it uses a lot of intake air. At higher altitudes, it offers great performance, at the cost of Liquid Fuel.
zh: Universal Aeronautics and Space Systems 与 Kerbal-Tech(K-Tech) 合作推出 T.R.A.P（四面体再膨胀空气推进器）发动机，这是新部件系列的首款产品。该发动机在低空性能良好，但会消耗大量进气。在高空，它能提供出色性能，但代价是消耗液体燃料。

src: Ever wanted to turn many lights on/off/blink with a single button click?
zh: 想要一键开启、关闭或闪烁多个灯光吗？

src: 2 sistemas solares nuevos uno de ellos es un sistema binario / 2 new solar systems, one of them is a binary system
zh: 2 个新太阳系，其中一个是双星系统

src: A structured science campaign for KSP's Science Mode, from first flight to deep-space exploration.
zh: 为 KSP 科学模式设计的结构化科学战役，涵盖从首次飞行到深空探索。
